title: Pulsar APX V3 Mouthpiece
description:
This mouthpiece replacement includes the silicone cushion insert and the ceramic screen that makes each hit smooth and clean. Made for the APX V3 Dry Herb Vape.

Details:
Plastic mouthpiece tip
Replacement part for the APX V3 Dry Herb Vape
Includes silicone insert & ceramic screen

Looking for Screens?
Recommend Vapir Prima Cap Screens

Disclaimer: Not reverse compatible with the APX V1 or V2 Dry Herb Vaporizer
